name: Hand☆Maid
source:
Main character is an alchemist who needs to combine countless parts to create a maid type automatic doll. Afterwards the automata must practice, raise exp and earn money to become the best automata among the rival alchemists.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名炼金术师，需要组合无数零件，制造女仆型自动人偶。完成后，自动人偶必须不断练习、积累经验并赚取金钱，最终在其他炼金术师的竞争作品中成为最优秀的人偶。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
